changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Add reply_count column to question table for performance optimization

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: UPDATE reply r SET r.like_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reply_likes rl WHERE rl.reply_id = r.reply_id )

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: UPDATE question q SET q.reply_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reply r WHERE r.question_id = q.question_id AND r.deleted = false AND r.visible = true )
